nodes.name: Send to ES Telegram inbox
nodes.notes: Uses env var TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID_ES. Set in n8n container env. Callback buttons fire the marketing-team-callback workflow.

meta.description: Spanish-language marketing pipeline. Twice a day, fetches ES-targeted articles with teacher_relevance >= 7 from the digital-observatory, generates per-platform drafts via Ollama, and pushes them to a dedicated ES Telegram chat with Approve/Edit/Skip inline buttons. Callback buttons are handled by the marketing-team-callback workflow.
